metadata.title: That 1 kill where my aim was AFK but Valorant said ‘Sure, why not?’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did that really just count?
My aim was clearly on vacation but the enemy said hi.
Click if your lucky shots confuse even you!
Valorant logic is the best kind of trolling.

Tap if your aim forgot the job but kills still happen!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #valorantlogic
